title: Four Monroe Homes 5-8 | Nashville Group Getaway
description:
The ultimate Nashville group stay. Enjoy four stylish Monroe Homes side-by-side, giving your group the perfect mix of togetherness, privacy, and comfort. Ideal for weddings, bachelorette trips, family gatherings, retreats, and special celebrations. Boutique design and plenty of space for up to 44 guests—all in one unforgettable stay.

This listing includes Monroe Homes 5–8.

Other things to note
Pet Policy:

We’re delighted to welcome your four-legged travel companion! We allow up to three dogs per stay for a fee of $150 per pet. To help us properly prepare for your arrival, please let us know in advance if you'll be bringing a dog with you.
